title: Ruppelt pressured to debunk his own book

tellings.quote: he he absolututely was pressured to basically debunk his own book.

plain: Edward J. Ruppelt, who wrote The Report on Unidentified Flying Objects, published in 1956, was later pushed into debunking his own book, according to the researcher Richard Dolan, who tells Michels without naming a source that Ruppelt "absolutely was pressured" to do so. Dolan does not say who applied the pressure. If true, it would mean the author of one of the first serious UFO books was made to take back what he had written.
